Margins, swept on this file on the final test_mp.exe (608 runs, one change per run; the units are level units, one is 2.8 screen px at 1280 x 720): every tap tick 1 to 4 either way wins in 57 of 64 runs, every tap point 2, 4 and 8 u either way in 86 of 96, every hold edge 1 to 4 either way in 72 of 72; the dense grid (ticks 12, points 8, hold edges 8) wins in 515 of 608, and the wins end on 780 to 791. The headline failures (17 of 232) are the 400 ms gate (3: shot 1 earlier than tick 26), a shot still in flight (5: a tap made before the previous portal is placed, shots 3 and 4) and a world that is not won (9: shot 6's aim 8 times and shot 3's pocket aim at x +8 once); the dense grid also fails on the door's progress and the walk's edges (tap 266 five ticks later and tap 312 five ticks earlier, where an earlier shot ends in a red cross because the door is not high enough; the walk's start, 205, seven ticks later and its end, 262, seven ticks earlier) and on shots 7 and 8 in flight (tap 680 five ticks later, tap 732 five ticks earlier). The one tight input is shot 6's aim (372, 66): x from 5 below to 2 above and y from 2 below to 1 above (the ray must clear the pole's top at y 80 and the portal must come within 22 u of the fireball's line y 85); shot 3's pocket aim (178, 64) wins from x 8 below (the grid's limit) to 5 above.

WHAT IT LEANS ON, AND WHAT IT DOES NOT SHOW. (1) The player pushes through the STANDING plank (left 205 to 262): a flagged plank against the unflagged player, a contact never measured on the original; if the original's plank holds him, this line is the port's and not the original's. (2) Shots 7 and 8 each place a third portal, so the cap must recycle the oldest (data/portals.json on_cap_recycle_oldest, labelled a GUESS; the original's PortalManager::insertPortal kills portals[0] above the cap, out/parity/asbc/all_functions.txt around L27566, read, not run).

(3) The carranca's third fireball, spat on 629: the clock is the script's, and this is the port's 60 Hz tick. (4) The barrel is pushed 1.8 u here and 24.9 u in the original (CMP-11, the friction step), so shot 4's tap is aimed at the barrel where the port leaves it. (5) It is an 8-shot line: the run is a medal 2 (8 portals, all 3 crystals: 916 and 917 on the walk, 915 in the room; the suite prints "door: medal 2, 8 portals, 12544 ms"), where the old route's six portals were a medal 3, so the medal's six-portal term is not met. A 6-shot line exists (out/parity/program/CMP18/fix/route/W3_stone_rest_barrel_fireball_kick.json, won 651) but its fireball passes the plank by a kick that is an artefact of the engine's order of a push against a joint limit.

Leans on R23 (the tap-time ray), G4 (a shot flies 3.2 u a tick), step 133 (the door's latch and the plate), the port's transit (the traveller set at the partner's own point, its velocity turned back; a traversal spends the pair, a fireball's carry does not), Fire and Demolish (a blast within 80 u with a clear line breaks a breakable wall) and planning step 197's order of the stone and the plank.
